dslRule:
<!id: modernize.use.stubutility2.findannotation>
<!description: Replace internal findAnnotation call with StubUtility2.findAnnotation where the original method was moved to a shared utility class.>
<!severity: HINT>
findAnnotation($arg1, $arg2) :: inClass("org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.text.correction.ModifierCorrectionSubProcessor")
=> org.eclipse.jdt.internal.corext.codemanipulation.StubUtility2.findAnnotation($arg1, $arg2)
;;
summary: Replaces unqualified calls to `findAnnotation` within `ModifierCorrectionSubProcessor` with a fully qualified call to `StubUtility2.findAnnotation`, reflecting a method move.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
